scope.globalSidecarPolicy: Separate fragment; no global design-system refresh.

following.viewportAnchor: Upper quarter of the passage viewport
following.passageTap: Seek within the current source/part using the shown timing mode

timing.ordinaryText: Estimated timing with visible drift guidance
timing.manualMatch: Select the narrated line, then Match at the current media time; intermediate timing remains estimated
timing.suppliedVtt: Supplied timestamps only for the source/part attached at import; narration pairing is unverified
timing.otherPart: No highlighting; explain the mismatch and offer another text track
timing.singleFileChapters: Estimated chapter jumps through the whole-recording timeline
timing.ambiguousMultipart: Choose the text chapter belonging to the current audio part
timing.reset: Clear manual anchors while retaining the chapter choice

acquisitionAndManagement.lookup: Companion source files and public Project Gutenberg results via Gutendex
acquisitionAndManagement.editionGuidance: Matching title alone does not establish matching narration
acquisitionAndManagement.removal: Native confirmation removes text and timing matches; audio, bookmarks, and listening progress remain

adaptiveTransport.frames: Existing compact, expanded, and hinge-aware Listening room
adaptiveTransport.ordinaryLayout: Weighted passage viewport above surfaceContainerLow transport
adaptiveTransport.tabletopLayout: Text above the hinge gap; scrollable transport below
adaptiveTransport.controls: Native listening-position slider, 30-second skips, play/pause, buffering progress
adaptiveTransport.textScaling: Existing Material sp typography and native scrolling

semantics: Current passage or Current passage, estimated timing state description
Click labels distinguish line selection, supplied-timestamp seek, and estimated seek
Material tabs, buttons, sheets, dialogs, and slider own native interaction states

evidence.captureMatrix: 24 original native PNGs: eight states across phone, phone-large-text, and expanded fold-labelled emulator configurations
evidence.limits: Isolated API 36 emulator with synthetic Garden Walk prose and real Media3 WAV transport; does not establish physical Samsung folding, gesture performance, or authenticated TorBox ebook delivery.
